about_the_game:
Astromattech is a brutal Twin-Stick Bullet Hell game for 1-4 players, set in a variety of procedurally-generated locations inspired by various sci-fi settings. Create and develop an arsenal of powerful weapons and companions to overcome mighty foes and become the most powerful bot in the Universe!

Travel to distant planets, attack enemy spaceships and eradicate enemy stations. Astromattech will take you through a galaxy of distinct environments, each hosting a variety of different enemies, resources and secrets to uncover. Set "Sail" through the stars and become a pioneer of a new Universe.

Gather the pieces from your fallen foes, repurposing their scraps to develop mighty weaponry and robots to assist in your epic of universal annihilation.

Construct a home to your own liking, an unfathomable fortress filled with beautiful machinery and underlings that will bend and obey to your every whim. 

  • Relax and play alone or in a party with up to three other players to experience a casual but intense wave-based survival with dynamic enemies that scale in difficulty and variety.

  • Extensive crafting options that allow you to tailor your experience how you see fit. Whether it's speed or strength, there is a playstyle for all.

  • Epic boss fights that will put you at the edge of your seat, testing even the most advanced droids.

  • Utilise a variety of upgrades and perks that will assist you in your encounters, offering additional support such as increased health, faster movement, reduced power consumption and more.
detailed_description:
Get Involved

Astromattech is a game inspired by creativity. We want to make this an experience that is truly enjoyable and to do this we know that your support is key. If you would like to shape the future of this game, join us on Discord and Patreon. Have your say!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10(64-bit OS required)
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible sound card

short_description: Astromattech is an action-packed space adventure where you raid enemy spaceships, planets and bases to gather valuable materials. Use this loot to enhance your character's abilities and construct a powerful army of robots. Strategize, upgrade, and conquer the galaxy in your quest for dominance!
